 Nagaland State Lottery Sambad Result 4.11.2026 Today 1PM, 6PM & 8PM LIVE: Dear Lottery Wednesday Winners List
 News oi-Pooja Jaiswar By Pooja Jaiswar 
 Updated: Wednesday, November 4, 2026, 18:29 [IST]
 Add as a preferred source on Google The Nagaland state has declared results of three Sambad Dear lotteries on November 4, 2026. These are Dear Spark Morning 1PM, Dear Regal Evening 6PM and Dear Dream Night 8PM lottery. All three are offering bumper prize of Rs 1 crore. In the total, there are six prizes each under these lotteries. The cost of per lottery ticket is Rs 6. The dear lotteries are transparent and conducted by the Directorate of Nagaland State Lotteries.
